summary: Duplicate prevention is implemented at multiple levels. The CQC pipeline uses immutable snapshots with checksum verification — reimport of the same data produces identical results. The incremental update (incremental_update.py) handles deduplication. Database migrations are forward-only with explicit safety: additive expand/contract changes, corrective migrations for isolated defects. The production README mandates that 'Commercial and unapproved mutation paths must remain fail-closed' — preventing accidental duplicate commercial actions. Stripe webhook integration tests exist in the prod-ready/webhook-integration-tests branch.
assertions: CQC pipeline: immutable snapshots with checksum → idempotent reimport
Fail-closed commercial paths prevent duplicate billing/delivery
Webhook integration tests in prod-ready branches
